offer: an AI outbound platform for early-stage B2B teams: it watches for buying signals like sales hires and launches, drafts the first email, and runs the follow-up sequence
proofPoints: Built for teams without a dedicated SDR
Every first email is approved by a person before it sends
Each draft cites the public signal it is based on

angles.signal: Lead with the strongest signal: name it in their words and connect it to the offer.
angles.peer: Speak to what a team at their stage is dealing with, using only the listed proof points. Never name or invent other companies.
angles.short: Three sentences at most: the signal, one line on the offer, the question.
